record.title: SIPA customer-property liquidation route
record.sub: Recover or resolve a failed institution
kv: Securities Investor Protection Act and the liquidation case.
A financially troubled SIPC-member broker-dealer has missing customer cash or securities and a SIPA liquidation is applicable.
Securities Investor Protection Corporation; Court-appointed SIPA trustees; SIPA liquidation estates

Confirm SIPC-member broker-dealer status and the statutory trigger. Establish customer status, asset classification, account facts, and claim deadlines. Apply SIPA's limits and the trustee/court process.
SIPC is distinct from FDIC deposit insurance; it does not protect market-value loss, ordinary investment losses, commodities/FX claims, or digital/crypto assets outside SIPA's security definition.
Securities Investor Protection Corporation: SIPC states that it protects customer cash and securities at financially troubled SIPC-member brokerage firms within SIPA's defined scope.
